title: Investigating the prognostic role of citrullination-related genes in breast cancer by combining transcriptomics, single-cell analysis and verification.
authors: He, Weijie; Fan, Shanji; Luo, Yongmei; Yi, Xinyu; Liu, Yingjie; He, Guicheng; Li, Zhimin; Li, Yuehua
one_liner_zh: 该研究基于转录组和单细胞分析筛选乳腺癌瓜氨酸化相关预后基因，仅含分子对接且非蛋白-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Citrullination, a process linked to autoimmune diseases, has been implicated in cancer, but its role in breast cancer (BRCA) remains unclear. This study aimed to identify citrullination-related genes (CRGs) associated with prognosis in BRCA. We utilized datasets from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA-BRCA) and Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO), pinpointing candidate genes by intersecting differentially expressed genes (DEGs) from TCGA-BRCA with known CRGs. Prognostic CRGs were selected using univariate Cox regression and Lasso regression analyses, and a predictive nomogram was created based on independent prognostic factors identified through multivariate Cox regression. Our findings revealed that SEZ6, S100B, SPIB, and TFF1 were key CRGs used to construct a risk model. High-risk BRCA patients exhibited immune-suppressive tumor microenvironments (TMEs) with low CD8(+) T cell mutation and enrichment in C1/C4 immune subtypes. In contrast, low-risk patients displayed high immune infiltration and enrichment in C2/C3/C6 subtypes. High expression of S100B, SPIB, and TFF1 was associated with increased immune infiltration by NK cells and T cells, while high SEZ6 expression was linked to neutrophil mutations, PD-L1 upregulation, and low CD8(+) T cell infiltration. Molecular docking studies explored the interactions of these CRGs with entinostat. In conclusion, SEZ6, S100B, SPIB, and TFF1 were identified as significant prognostic genes in BRCA, providing insights into BRCA pathogenesis and potential personalized treatment strategies.
abstract_zh: 瓜氨酸化（citrullination）是一种与自身免疫疾病相关的进程，已在癌症中被涉及，但其在乳腺癌（BRCA）中的作用仍不清楚。本研究旨在识别与BRCA预后相关的瓜氨酸化相关基因（CRGs）。我们利用了来自癌症基因组图谱（TCGA-BRCA）和基因表达综合数据库（GEO）的数据集，通过将TCGA-BRCA中的差异表达基因（DEGs）与已知CRGs取交集来定位候选基因。使用单变量Cox回归和Lasso回归分析筛选预后CRGs，并基于多变量Cox回归确定的独立预后因素构建了预测性列线图。我们的发现揭示，SEZ6、S100B、SPIB和TFF1是用于构建风险模型的关键CRGs。高风险BRCA患者表现出免疫抑制性肿瘤微环境（TMEs），其特征为低CD8(+) T细胞突变和C1/C4免疫亚型富集。相反，低风险患者表现出高免疫浸润和C2/C3/C6亚型富集。S100B、SPIB和TFF1的高表达与NK细胞和T细胞的免疫浸润增加相关，而SEZ6的高表达与中性粒细胞突变、PD-L1上调及低CD8(+) T细胞浸润相关。分子对接研究探讨了这些CRGs与恩替诺特（entinostat）的相互作用。总之，SEZ6、S100B、SPIB和TFF1被确定为BRCA中的重要预后基因，为BRCA发病机制和潜在个性化治疗策略提供了见解。
